name: r6h_PageStep
notes: run one frame of the page state machine (enter/fade in/run/fade out and switch to the queued page) and tail-call 0x0006C3F0; modern cl pushes the float argument 8.0 from .rdata instead of as an immediate

name: r6h_FxRespawn
notes: respawn title particle idx at a random spot outside the central box with random speeds from its kind record; regargs: idx=EAX alt=ECX kind=EDX; modern cl stores the float bounds and the +-1 sign as immediates instead of loading them from .rdata and scales the 20-byte record index by addressing where the original uses shl 2

name: r6h_TitleDraw
notes: draw the title screen (letters or background quad or black) and move/fade/draw/respawn the title particles; calls 0x0006C270 with EAX=i ECX=alt EDX=kind; loop strength reduction: modern cl biases the particle pointer by +4 (0x3E662C; -4/+0xC field offsets) where the original points at the record and takes &life as +0x10; modern cl builds 1.0 with fld1 and loads the float arguments -256/-224 from .rdata where the original pushes them as immediates

name: r6h_DemoCreate
notes: create a demo (cutscene) object and its 0x184-byte work block (demo.c lines 0xDF/0xE1); look up its flags by key; copy the scene view; set up key arrays/slot holder/sound tag; register it; the original addresses the 24-byte view copy from &wk->view (+0..+0x14) where modern cl uses the absolute field offsets +4..+0x18

name: r6h_KeyListMerge
notes: merge the demo key list *src into *dst removing (moving or releasing) keys of *dst equal to the first key of *src; join the lists and reset the optional cursor to its first node

name: r6h_TexScrollUpdate
notes: advance the scrolling texture layers (type 5: 0x100-byte layers; type 1: 0x108-byte layers) of every animated texture object by the frame time and wrap the offsets into 0..1; modern cl builds the constant 1.0 with fld1 instead of loading it from .rdata (same value)

name: r6h_TexAnimLoad
notes: build an @TXA texture animation table from a text file: count non-empty lines; allocate header plus 16-byte frames (tag 0x23C); parse position (tokens 3/4 divided by the texture size) and frame time (token 7) per line; modern cl merges the four magic byte stores @TXA into one dword store

name: r6h_MenuBuildList
notes: build the item list of a menu page from event flags and stats (page 0: fixed items; other pages: upgradeable stats below 2 offset by their base id) and return/store the item count

name: r6h_StatusFreeTextures
notes: reset the texture heap and release the loaded textures of the current status screen sub-page (sub-page 0 keeps them when the next page byte is 2)

name: r6h_DemoPlayerStep
notes: run one step of the demo player state machine (start; load the twelve tracks and rebuild/bind key and event lists; prepare events; wait and start; finish) releasing replaced lists; returns 0 or the list error

name: r6h_EventTrigger
notes: set the story flag of an event object trigger index for the current chapter and stage (kinds 0x11/0x19) and clear its pending bit 28

name: r6h_ScriptStep
notes: run one step of a two-stage event script (reset/arm modes; state 10 question with answer 2 accepted; state 11 waits for the id; 0x63 closes); assert-style hangs when the script reader fails or the id is not 11

name: r6h_NodeApplyXform
notes: build the local matrix of an active node transform (identity; Y/X/Z rotations from degrees; rows scaled; translation) and pass it with arg to the transform target; -1 without node or transform

name: r6h_ActorSyncBody
notes: copy actor position/rotation into its body (w = 1) and update the body node (node position only when node-driven; else rotation/scale/position matrix); modern cl stores the constant 1.0f as an immediate instead of loading it from .rdata (same value)

name: r6h_CurvesSet3
notes: set up three 3-key curves (values a[i]/b[i]/c[i] at key times 0/30/60) carving each from its buffer and preparing it; modern cl stores the float constants 30.0 and 60.0 as immediates instead of loading them from .rdata (same values)

name: r6h_HitTestPlayer
notes: test the attack box of an actor against a hit box (centre transformed by its node); on a hit pass the player-to-body direction to the player hit handler (kind 0x1F requests 0x00135EB0(1)); returns 1 on a hit; modern cl stores the w = 1.0f components as immediates instead of loading them from .rdata (same value)

name: r6h_WanderStep
notes: step a wandering object: start a wander with random duration and signed random turn rate; run the 120-unit timer then flag bit 30 and state -1; clear speed and turn the heading wrapping into -pi..pi

name: r6h_SpinnerStep
notes: step a spinning object: on start set its scale (kind 0x4E: 1.5 plus model colour 255/255/64/128) and pick a random spin direction; then turn the heading by 0.0314 per frame unit wrapping into -pi..pi; modern cl stores the float constants 1.5/2.0/255/64/128 as immediates instead of loading them from .rdata (same values)

name: r6h_MotionReset
notes: reset a motion record to defaults (scalars 0 except 1.0/10.0/4.0 and target -1; five vectors (0;0;0;1); words at +0x90..+0xD8 cleared); modern cl stores the float constants 1.0/10.0/4.0 as immediates instead of loading them from .rdata (same values)
